description_en: Queries the device information of an agent when the agent goes offline unexpectedly
description_zh: 当坐席出现异常下线的情况时，查询坐席的设备信息
name: ListAgentDevices

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the call center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The collection of RAM IDs.

If no data is specified, the device information of the current agent is queried. Separate multiple RAM IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
RamID的集合。

如果没有数据则查询当前坐席的设备信息，查询多个ramID信息用“,”分隔
parameters.name: ram_ids

parameters.help_en: The start time. Default value: 00:00 of the current day
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，默认当天时间的0点时刻
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Default value: the current time
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，默认当前时间
parameters.name: stop_time
